chapter: Postwar Chicago, Janis and De Paris
title: De Paris band's end and Ryan's move to 54th Street
summary: The band never toured and Ryan's moved from 52nd Street, lasting about a year before closing.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So it was a pretty interesting couple of years that you had with de Paris. Where did that band play besides New York? Did that band ever tour?
It didn't. It stayed right in New York.

After we finished 52nd Street, they was supposed to be tearing that whole block down or something, for Rockefeller Center. But anyway, Jimmy Ryan's has gone to another place, 54th Street...yeah, right off of Seventh

Avenue. A small place... We lasted... Oh, I guess we lasted there, oh, about six months, probably a year. I know it went to six months. And they had some difficulties down there, he and the boss, so they let him out. After that, no more.
